name: Virtual assistant / administrative support (category)
summary: Remote administrative support, such as inbox, calendar, documents, CRM upkeep and follow-ups, done for one employer or for several clients from home.
what_you_do: You manage email and calendars, keep contact lists and CRM records accurate, prepare documents, book meetings and chase follow-ups for a manager or for several small-business clients. Some roles add phone or email outreach, shipping coordination or industry paperwork such as real-estate forms.
who_it_may_fit: You are organized, write clearly and like keeping someone else's working day running from home.
Job Bank lists a national median of about $26.44/hr for administrative assistants (NOC 13110)
Job Bank outlook pages say there may be openings for virtual assistants who support multiple clients
Mostly written, independent work during business hours
Remote part-time postings for people in Canada exist, e.g. 15–25 hrs/week at $19–$23/hr with training provided (posted 2026-10-13)
who_it_may_not_fit: You want work that needs no office experience, or you dislike a constant stream of small requests and deadlines.
Ontario's 2025–2027 outlook is only 'Moderate', and Job Bank warns that AI, virtual agents and automation may change or cut some admin tasks
Many remote VA roles want years of admin experience or niche skills: one $25/hr contractor role required Canadian real-estate admin experience and was limited to ON, AB and SK
Freelance or contract VA work usually means no benefits, your own equipment, and your own tax and GST/HST obligations
'Virtual assistant' is a common job-scam title. Fake employers send a cheque to deposit and ask you to send money back for equipment or software
Never pay for equipment, training or onboarding up front, and never forward money for an 'employer'

requirements.education: Job Bank: usually a college diploma, a short apprenticeship or more than 6 months of on-the-job training

conditions_notes: Employee roles give steady hours. Freelance VAs depend on keeping clients. Job Bank outlooks range from Moderate (Ontario 2025–2027) to Very good (Alberta 2024–2026).
Some employers train new hires (one remote part-time posting said 'training provided'). Experienced-VA contractor roles expect you to start with little or no training.

advertised_rate.note: Job Bank national low and high wages for administrative assistants (NOC 13110), with a median of $26.44/hr (2023–2024 Labour Force Survey, updated 2025-11-19; seen via search summary). These are employee wages. Remote postings read on 2026-10-13 paid $19–$23/hr (part-time employee) and $25/hr (contractor). Freelance VA rates were not evidenced.

summary: Working Solutions contracts independent agents in the US and Canada to handle customer calls for client programs from home, paid per productive minute.
what_you_do: You certify for a client program (e.g. customer care, sales or benefits enrollment), book available time slots, and handle customer contacts from home. You are paid only for productive minutes and invoice as an independent contractor.
who_it_may_fit: You want self-scheduled phone work from home and can accept contractor status and uneven hours.

Independent contractor: no benefits; you handle your own taxes

Complaint-site reports (unverified) of disputed final payments; province rules not stated

name: Remote virtual executive assistant (Zirtual)
summary: Zirtual matches experienced virtual executive assistants in the US or Canada with busy professionals as independent contractors.
what_you_do: You manage clients' calendars, inboxes, travel, documents and research remotely during business hours, replying to clients within two hours and sending weekly usage reports. An account supervisor supports you with client relationships.
who_it_may_fit: You are an experienced admin/executive assistant in Canada who wants mostly written remote work during business hours.
Posting explicitly accepts residents of the US or Canada
Mostly written/independent work (email, calendar, documents)
Business-hours schedule; no round-the-clock availability
Bilingual English/French is a plus
who_it_may_not_fit: You are new to admin work or need a set wage and benefits.
Requires 2–4+ years as an executive or administrative assistant and 50+ WPM typing
Contractor pay is a percentage of client plans; average $1,500–$3,800/month depends on client mix (currency not stated)
No equipment provided; you supply computer, internet and phone
Must respond to clients within 2 hours during business hours (PST or EST)
Zirtual warns that scammers impersonate its recruiters; real emails come only from @zirtual.com

conditions_notes: Earnings depend on number and size of assigned client plans.
Account supervisor provides guidance; formal training not described.

advertised_rate.note: Employer-stated average monthly earnings range in a July 2026 posting seen via Indeed; % of client monthly plans; currency not stated.

fees: None per Zirtual's posting (never asks candidates for payment); you bear your own equipment, internet and phone costs and taxes.
economics_notes: Employer-stated average monthly earnings range in a July 2026 posting seen via Indeed; % of client monthly plans; currency not stated.
